claims.text: The authors experimented with CNN/DailyMail to evaluate the performance of their HiStruct+ models against strong baselines and to assess the effectiveness of hierarchical position information in summarization.
The hierarchical structure of CNN/DailyMail is less pronounced compared to other datasets, motivating the authors to explore how their model performs in this context.
